P1_HRMS_vs_our_build._convention_drift: Nine compounds are reported as [M+Na]+ and A-13 as [M+H]+, in the same column. Both reproduce. This is trap 2, measured.

P2_Fig1c_independent_property_table._source: Fig 1c is a pure BITMAP -- the JATS declares table-count=0 -- so its cells are transcribed by eye. A single misread character breaks the 10/10 formula match, which is what makes the transcription checkable.

P3_free_checks_the_authors_left._best_one: The printed 77-92% yield range is a number the authors drew and never computed, and it settles their own off-by-one: 92% is A-9's yield alone, so A-9 is in the series that Fig 1a labels 'A10-17-2Z'.

P4_name_token_vs_chain_length.rule_measured: A-N carries an acyl chain of N+1 carbons: A-9 is decanoyl (C10), A-17 is stearoyl (C18). The token counts the alkyl carbons BEYOND the ester carbonyl.

substructure_sweep_SUPERSET._positive_control: The first version of the core SMARTS demanded a ring CH2 and so could not match cKK-E12 itself; it reported a clean 0. A sweep that misses its own known positive is broken, not loose. The positive control that caught it is now permanent.

P5_corpus_overlap._and_the_wrong_namespace: A-N names a HELPER phospholipid, not an ionizable lipid, so an IL_name join would be wrong twice over.

P6_anchors_C10_posture._recorded_by_hand_in_PROVENANCE.md: provenance/structure_check.py, check_anchor_independence.py and check_anchor_coverage.py were NOT run: they write tracked files other agents read.
P6_anchors_C10_posture.anchor_chain_lengths: A-9 (C10 acyl) and A-17 (C18 acyl) -- deliberately different lengths
P6_anchors_C10_posture.guard_1_AST: walks make_reference.py's own syntax tree at run time for RDKit editing primitives and an `assemble` import; inspects Call/Import nodes ONLY, never string constants, so the ban list cannot match itself
P6_anchors_C10_posture.guard_2_template_provenance: no string literal of >=25 chars in make_reference.py may be a substring of any enumerated SMILES -- F-037's defect stated directly, which byte-comparison of the OUTPUT cannot see
P6_anchors_C10_posture._and_that_is_not_the_signal: A correct re-derivation canonicalises to the same string as a correct enumeration. That is exactly why C10's own anchor_may_be_a_copy missed F-037.

P7_seeded_mutations._credit_rule: A seed is credited only if its child process REACHED a METRIC line. Two seeds were refused credit on the first run for exiting before their metric (a missing lib path, a missing input file); the harness was fixed, not the seeds.
P7_seeded_mutations.measured_blind_spot: S5 -- swapping the adamantylacetyl and fatty acyl on ALL TEN compounds leaves the HRMS gate GREEN. Measured delta: formula identical, exact mass identical to 0.000000 Da. Seed G3 shows the InChIKey anchor gate DOES catch the same defect (0/2 agreements), so the two checks have complementary coverage.
P7_seeded_mutations.measured_sensitivity_limit: S10 -- shifting every Fig 3h bar slot by half the 22.8 px pitch breaks both the sign count and the rank, so the slot positions are load-bearing at that scale and are detected, not assumed.

ids.X-1: Which hydroxyl of the glycerol carries the adamantylacetyl group

ids.X-6: Which sterol and which molar ratio LNP1 uses
